people.descriptor: Crown Prince and Posthumously Honored Emperor

label.en: vice director of the Southern Directorate for Palace Provisions
Grand Councilor of the Imperial Secretariat
Great King of the Northern Chancellery
acting commissioner of the Northern Bureau
director of the Northern Directorate for Palace Provisions
military commissioner of the Jingjiang Army

units.zh: 蕭巖壽耶律撒剌蕭速撒耶律撻不也蕭撻不也蕭忽古耶律石柳
units.en: Xiao Yanshou, Yelu Sala, Xiao Susa, Yelu Tabuye, Xiao Tabuye, Xiao Hugu, and Yelu Shiliu
units.literal: Xiao Yanshou, Yelu Sala, Xiao Susa, Yelu Tabuye, Xiao Tabuye, Xiao Hugu, Yelu Shiliu

units.zh: 蕭巖壽，乙室部人。
units.en: Xiao Yanshou came from the Yishi tribe.
units.literal: Xiao Yanshou was a man of the Yishi tribe.

units.zh: 性剛直尚氣，仕重熙末。
units.en: Upright and spirited by nature, he began his career late in the Chongxi reign.
units.literal: By nature upright and proud of spirit; he entered office at the end of the Chongxi era.

units.zh: 道宗即位，皇太后屢稱其賢，由是進用。
units.en: After Emperor Daozong acceded, the Empress Dowager repeatedly praised his merit, and he was promoted on that account.
units.literal: When Emperor Daozong took the throne, the Empress Dowager repeatedly praised his worth; thereby he was advanced and employed.

units.zh: 上出獵較，巖壽典其事，未嘗高下於心，帝益重之。
units.en: Whenever the emperor went out hunting for sport, Yanshou managed the arrangements without favoritism, which deepened the emperor's regard for him.
units.literal: When the emperor went out to hunt and compete, Yanshou directed the affair, never playing favorites in his heart; the emperor valued him all the more.

units.zh: 歷文班太保、同知樞密院事。
units.en: He rose through the posts of Grand Guardian of the Literary Office and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: He successively served as Grand Guardian of the Literary Office and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 咸雍四年，從耶律仁先伐阻卜，破之，有詔留屯，亡歸者眾，由是鐫兩官。
units.en: In the fourth year of Xianyong he joined Yelu Renxian's campaign against the Zubu; after their defeat he was ordered to hold the frontier, but so many men deserted that he was demoted two ranks.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Xianyong, he followed Yelu Renxian in attacking the Zubu and defeated them; there was an edict to remain and garrison; those who fled back were many; on this account two ranks were cut from him.

units.zh: 十年，討敵烈部有功，為其部節度使。
units.en: In the tenth year he campaigned successfully against the Dilie tribe and was appointed its military commissioner.
units.literal: In the tenth year, he attacked the Dilie tribe with merit and became military commissioner of that tribe.

units.zh: 大康元年，同知南院宣徽使事，遷北面林牙。
units.en: In the first year of Dakang he became vice director of the Southern Directorate for Palace Provisions and was transferred to Northern Imperial Scribe.
units.literal: In the first year of Dakang, he served as vice director of the Southern Chancellery Directorate for Palace Provisions and was transferred to Northern Imperial Scribe.

units.zh: 密奏乙辛以皇太子知國政，心不自安，與張孝傑數相過從，恐有陰謀，動搖太子。
units.en: In a secret memorial he warned that Yelu Yixin, uneasy now that the crown prince governed state affairs, was meeting Zhang Xiaojie repeatedly and might be plotting against the heir.
units.literal: In a secret memorial he reported that because the Crown Prince administered state affairs, Yixin was ill at ease, met often with Zhang Xiaojie, and he feared there was a covert plot to shake the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 上悟，出乙辛為中京留守。
units.en: The emperor took the point and posted Yixin as regent (liushou) of Zhongjing.
units.literal: The emperor understood, and sent Yixin out as military commissioner at Zhongjing.

units.zh: 會乙辛生日，上遣近臣耶律白斯本賜物為壽，乙辛因私屬白上：「臣見奸人在朝，陛下孤危。
units.en: On Yixin's birthday the emperor sent the courtier Yelu Baisiben with gifts; Yixin asked him privately to tell the throne, "I see villains at court and Your Majesty isolated in danger.
units.literal: It happened to be Yixin's birthday; the emperor sent the close minister Yelu Aisiben to present gifts in congratulation. Yixin privately entrusted him to tell the emperor: "Your servant sees wicked men in court; Your Majesty stands alone in peril.

units.zh: 身雖在外，竊用寒心。」
units.en: Though I am away from court, I cannot stop worrying for your safety."
units.literal: Though my person is outside, within I feel cold at heart."

units.zh: 白斯本還，以聞。
units.en: When Baisiben returned he reported this to the emperor.
units.literal: Aisiben returned and reported it.

units.zh: 上遣人賜乙辛車，諭曰：「無慮弗用，行將召矣。」
units.en: The emperor sent Yixin a carriage with the message, "Have no fear—I shall summon you back soon."
units.literal: The emperor sent someone to bestow a carriage on Yixin, instructing him: "Do not worry and do not decline; soon you will be recalled."

units.zh: 由是反疑巖壽，出為順義軍節度使。
units.en: From this the emperor instead grew suspicious of Yanshou and appointed him military commissioner of the Shunyi Army.
units.literal: Thereby he came instead to suspect Yanshou and sent him out as military commissioner of the Shunyi Army.

units.zh: 乙辛復入為樞密使，流巖壽於烏隗路，終身拘作。
units.en: Yixin was brought back as Bureau Commissioner; Yanshou was banished to Wulilu for lifelong corvée labor.
units.literal: Yixin returned and became bureau commissioner; Yanshou was exiled to Wulilu and put to lifelong compulsory labor.

units.zh: 巖壽雖竄逐，恒以社稷為憂，時人為之語曰：「以狼牧羊，何能久長！」
units.en: Even in exile he never ceased to anguish over the realm, and people said, "A wolf herding sheep cannot last long!"
units.literal: Though Yanshou was driven off, he constantly grieved for the altars of state. People of the time made a saying of it: "Using a wolf to herd sheep—how can it last long!"

units.zh: 三年，乙辛誣巖壽與謀廢立事，執還殺之，年四十九。
units.en: In the third year Yixin accused him of plotting to depose the emperor and enthrone another; he was seized, brought back, and executed at forty-nine.
units.literal: In the third year, Yixin framed Yanshou for plotting deposition and enthronement; he was seized, brought back, and killed—aged forty-nine.

units.zh: 乾統間，贈同中書門下平章事，繪像宜福殿。
units.en: Under Qiantong he was posthumously made Grand Councilor of the Imperial Secretariat and had his portrait placed in Yifu Hall.
units.literal: During the Qiantong period, he was posthumously granted Grand Councilor of the Imperial Secretariat and his portrait painted in Yifu Hall.

units.zh: 巖壽廉直，面折廷諍，多與乙辛忤，故及於難。
units.en: Incorruptible and outspoken, he often faced down opponents at court; his repeated clashes with Yixin brought him to ruin.
units.literal: Yanshou was honest and upright, rebuking straight to the face in court remonstrance; he often opposed Yixin, and therefore met disaster.

units.zh: 耶律撒剌，字堇隱，南院大王磨魯古之孫。
units.en: Yelu Sala, whose style was Jinyin, was a grandson of the Southern Chancellery King Molugu.
units.literal: Yelu Sala, styled Jinyin, was grandson of Molugu, the Southern Chancellery King.

units.zh: 性忠直沈厚。
units.en: He was loyal, upright, and grave in character.
units.literal: By nature loyal, upright, deep, and substantial.

units.zh: 清寧初，累遷西南面招討使，以治稱。
units.en: Early in Qingning he rose through posts to Southwest Pacification Commissioner and won renown for his administration.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning he was repeatedly promoted to Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest and was famed for his governance.

units.zh: 咸雍九年，改北院大王。
units.en: In the ninth year of Xianyong he was made Great King of the Northern Chancellery.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Xianyong, he was transferred to Great King of the Northern Chancellery.

units.zh: 未幾，為契丹行宮都部署。
units.en: Soon after he became chief deployment officer of the Khitan itinerant palace.
units.literal: Before long, he became chief deployment officer of the Khitan itinerant palace.

units.zh: 大康二年，耶律乙辛為中京留守，詔百官廷議，欲復召之，群臣無敢正言。
units.en: In the second year of Dakang, with Yelu Yixin as regent of Zhongjing, the court deliberated recalling him—yet none of the ministers dared speak plainly.
units.literal: In the second year of Dakang, Yelu Yixin was military commissioner at Zhongjing; an edict called the hundred officials to court deliberation, wishing to recall him again; none of the ministers dared speak frankly.

units.zh: 撒剌獨奏曰：「蕭巖壽言乙辛有罪，不可為樞臣，故陛下出之；
units.en: Sala alone memorialized, "Xiao Yanshou showed Yixin guilty of crimes unfit for a bureau chief, and Your Majesty sent him away;
units.literal: Sala alone submitted: "Xiao Yanshou said Yixin had guilt and could not serve as bureau minister, so Your Majesty sent him out;

units.zh: 今復召，恐天下生疑。」
units.en: To summon him back now will only breed suspicion throughout the realm."
units.literal: if he is now recalled, I fear the empire will grow doubtful."

units.zh: 進諫者三，不納，左右為之震悚。
units.en: He pressed his advice three times without success; those around the throne trembled at his boldness.
units.literal: He advanced remonstrance three times; it was not accepted; those left and right were shaken in awe for him.

units.zh: 乙辛復為樞密使，見撒剌，讓曰：「與君無憾，何獨異議？」
units.en: When Yixin returned as commissioner he confronted Sala: "I bear you no personal grudge—why stand alone in opposition?"
units.literal: Yixin again became bureau commissioner; seeing Sala, he reproached him: "Between us there is no resentment—why oppose alone?"

units.zh: 撒剌曰：「此社稷計，何憾之有！」
units.en: Sala replied, "This concerns the fate of the state, not private resentment!"
units.literal: Sala said: "This is a plan for the altars of state—what resentment is there!"

units.zh: 乙辛誣撒剌與速撒同謀廢立，詔按無跡，出為始平軍節度使。
units.en: Yixin accused Sala and Susa of plotting deposition; though the inquiry found nothing, Sala was posted as military commissioner of Shiping.
units.literal: Yixin framed Sala and Susa as jointly plotting deposition and enthronement; an edict investigated and found no trace; he was sent out as military commissioner of the Shiping Army.

units.zh: 及蕭訛都斡誣首，竟遣使殺之。
units.en: When Xiao Eduogan corroborated the frame-up, an envoy was finally sent to execute him.
units.literal: When Xiao Eduogan made the false accuser's confession, in the end an envoy was sent to kill him.

units.zh: 乾統間，追封漆水郡王，繪像宜福殿，仍追贈三子官爵。
units.en: Under Qiantong he was posthumously made Prince of Qishui, his portrait placed in Yifu Hall, and his three sons granted posthumous ranks.
units.literal: During Qiantong, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui and his portrait painted in Yifu Hall; his three sons' offices and titles were also posthumously granted.

units.zh: 蕭速撒，字禿魯堇，突呂不部人。
units.en: Xiao Susa, whose style was Tulujin, came from the Tulubu tribe.
units.literal: Xiao Susa, styled Tulujin, was a man of the Tulubu tribe.

units.zh: 性沈毅。
units.en: He was deep and resolute in temperament.
units.literal: By nature deep and resolute.

units.zh: 重熙間，累遷右護衛太保。
units.en: During Chongxi he rose through posts to Grand Guardian of the Right Imperial Guard.
units.literal: During the Chongxi era, he was repeatedly promoted to Grand Guardian of the Right Imperial Guard.

units.zh: 蒲奴裏叛，從耶律義先往討，執首亂陶得裏以歸。
units.en: When Punuli rebelled he joined Yelu Yixian's punitive campaign, captured the ringleader Taodeli, and brought him back.
units.literal: Punuli rebelled; he followed Yelu Yixian to attack, seized the rebel leader Taodeli, and returned.

units.zh: 清寧中，歷北面林牙、彰國軍節度使，入為北院樞密副使。
units.en: Under Qingning he served as Northern Imperial Scribe and military commissioner of the Zhangguo Army before entering the capital as vice commissioner of the Northern Bureau.
units.literal: During Qingning he successively served as Northern Imperial Scribe and military commissioner of the Zhangguo Army, and entered office as vice commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 咸雍十年，經略西南邊，撤宋堡障，戍以皮室軍，上嘉之。
units.en: In the tenth year of Xianyong he managed the southwestern frontier, dismantled Song border forts, and stationed the Pishi army there—the emperor commended his work.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Xianyong, he directed strategy on the southwestern frontier, removed Song fortifications and barriers, and garrisoned with the Pishi army; the emperor praised him.

units.zh: 大康二年，知北院樞密使事。
units.en: In the second year of Dakang he became acting commissioner of the Northern Bureau.
units.literal: In the second year of Dakang, he served as acting commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 耶律乙辛權寵方盛，附麗者多至通顯，速撒未嘗造門。
units.en: While Yelu Yixin's power was at its peak and hangers-on won high office, Susa never once called at his door.
units.literal: Yelu Yixin's power and favor were then at their height; many who attached to him rose to high visibility, but Susa never once visited his gate.

units.zh: 乙辛銜之，誣構速撒首謀廢立。
units.en: Yixin resented him and accused him of leading a plot to depose the emperor and enthrone another.
units.literal: Yixin bore a grudge against him and framed Susa as chief plotter of deposition and enthronement.

units.zh: 按之無驗，出為上京留守。
units.en: The inquiry found no evidence, and he was posted as military commissioner at Shangjing.
units.literal: The investigation found no proof; he was sent out as military commissioner at Shangjing.

units.zh: 乙辛復令蕭訛都斡以前事誣告，上怒，不復加訊，遣使殺之。
units.en: Yixin had Xiao Eduogan renew the accusation; the enraged emperor questioned him no further and sent an envoy to put him to death.
units.literal: Yixin again had Xiao Eduogan accuse him on the former matter; the emperor was angry, did not further question him, and sent an envoy to kill him.

units.zh: 時方盛暑，屍諸原野，容色不變，烏鵲不敢近。
units.en: It was high summer; his body lay on the plain unchanged in countenance, and neither crows nor magpies would come near.
units.literal: It was then the height of summer; his corpse was left on the open plain, his countenance unchanged, and crows and magpies dared not approach.

units.zh: 乾統間，追封蘭陵郡王，繪像宜福殿。
units.en: Under Qiantong he was posthumously made Prince of Lanling and his portrait placed in Yifu Hall.
units.literal: During Qiantong, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling and his portrait painted in Yifu Hall.

units.zh: 耶律撻不也，字撒班，系出季父房。
units.en: Yelu Tabuye, whose style was Saban, belonged to the younger father's lineage.
units.literal: Yelu Tabuye, styled Saban, came from the lineage of the younger father's house.

units.zh: 父高家，仕至林牙，重熙間破夏人於金肅軍有功，優加賞賚。
units.en: His father Gaojia rose to Imperial Scribe; in Chongxi he defeated the Xia at Jinsu Army with distinction and received exceptional rewards.
units.literal: His father Gaojia rose in office to Imperial Scribe; during Chongxi he defeated the Xia people at Jinsu Army with merit and received especially generous rewards.

units.zh: 撻不也清寧中補牌印郎君，累遷永興宮使。
units.en: Under Qingning Tabuye entered service as Seal and Patent Gentleman and rose to commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.
units.literal: Tabuye during Qingning was appointed Seal and Patent Gentleman and was repeatedly promoted to commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.

units.zh: 九年，平重元之亂，以功知點檢司事，賜平亂功臣，為懷德軍節度使。
units.en: In the ninth year he helped suppress Chongyuan's revolt, was made director of the Inspection Office, granted the title Meritorious Pacifier of Disorder, and appointed military commissioner of the Huaide Army.
units.literal: In the ninth year, he pacified Chongyuan's rebellion; for merit he was made director of the Inspection Office, granted the title Meritorious Pacifier of Disorder, and made military commissioner of the Huaide Army.

units.zh: 咸雍五年，遷遙輦克。
units.en: In the fifth year of Xianyong he was transferred to Yaolianke.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Xianyong, he was transferred to Yaolianke.

units.zh: 大康三年，授北院宣徽使。
units.en: In the third year of Dakang he was made director of the Northern Directorate for Palace Provisions.
units.literal: In the third year of Dakang, he was appointed director of the Northern Directorate for Palace Provisions.

units.zh: 耶律乙辛謀害太子，撻不也知其奸，欲殺乙辛及蕭特裏得、蕭十三等。
units.en: When Yelu Yixin plotted against the crown prince, Tabuye saw through his treachery and meant to kill Yixin along with Xiao Telide, Xiao Shisan, and their faction.
units.literal: Yelu Yixin plotted to harm the Crown Prince; Tabuye knew his treachery and wished to kill Yixin together with Xiao Telide, Xiao Shisan, and others.

units.zh: 乙辛知之，令其黨誣構撻不也與廢立事，殺之。
units.en: Yixin learned of this and had his followers accuse Tabuye of plotting deposition; he was executed.
units.literal: Yixin learned of it and had his faction frame Tabuye for plotting deposition and enthronement, and killed him.

units.zh: 乾統間，追封漆水郡王，繪像宜福殿。
units.en: Under Qiantong he was posthumously made Prince of Qishui and his portrait placed in Yifu Hall.
units.literal: During Qiantong, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui and his portrait painted in Yifu Hall.

units.zh: 蕭撻不也，字斡裏端，國舅郡王高九之孫。
units.en: Xiao Tabuye, whose style was Woliduan, was a grandson of Imperial Uncle Prince of the Commandery Gao Jiu.
units.literal: Xiao Tabuye, styled Woliduan, was grandson of Imperial Uncle Prince of the Commandery Gao Jiu.

units.zh: 性剛直。
units.en: He was upright and unyielding by nature.
units.literal: By nature upright and unyielding.

units.zh: 咸雍中，補祗候郎君。
units.en: During Xianyong he entered service as Attendant Gentleman.
units.literal: During Xianyong he was appointed Attendant Gentleman.

units.zh: 大康元年，為彰湣宮使，尚趙國公主，拜駙馬都尉。
units.en: In the first year of Dakang he was made commissioner of the Zhangmin Palace, married the Princess of Zhao, and invested as Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant.
units.literal: In the first year of Dakang, he became commissioner of the Zhangmin Palace, married the Princess of Zhao State, and was invested as Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant.

units.zh: 三年，改同知漢人行宮都部署。
units.en: In the third year he was made vice chief deployment officer of the Han itinerant palace.
units.literal: In the third year, he was transferred to vice chief deployment officer of the Han itinerant palace.

units.zh: 與北院宣徽使耶律撻不也善，乙辛嫉之，令人誣告謀廢立事。
units.en: He was close to Yelu Tabuye, director of the Northern Directorate for Palace Provisions; Yixin resented this and had him falsely accused of plotting deposition.
units.literal: He was on good terms with Yelu Tabuye, director of the Northern Directorate for Palace Provisions; Yixin envied him and had someone falsely accuse him of plotting deposition and enthronement.

units.zh: 不勝搒掠，誣伏。
units.en: Unable to bear torture, he confessed under duress.
units.literal: Unable to endure beating and torture, he falsely confessed.

units.zh: 上引問，昏聵不能自陳，遂見殺。
units.en: The emperor questioned him personally; too muddled to defend himself, he was put to death.
units.literal: The emperor summoned him for questioning; muddled and unable to plead his own case, he was then killed.

units.zh: 乾統間，追封蘭陵郡王，繪像宜福殿。
units.en: Under Qiantong he was posthumously made Prince of Lanling and his portrait placed in Yifu Hall.
units.literal: During Qiantong, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling and his portrait painted in Yifu Hall.

units.zh: 蕭忽古，字阿斯憐，性忠直，趫捷有力。
units.en: Xiao Hugu, whose style was Asilian, was loyal and upright, quick and powerfully built.
units.literal: Xiao Hugu, styled Asilian, was by nature loyal and upright, nimble and strong.

units.zh: 甫冠，補禁軍。
units.en: As soon as he came of age he entered the imperial guard.
units.literal: Just upon coming of age, he was appointed to the forbidden army.

units.zh: 咸雍初，從招討使耶律趙三討番部之違命者。
units.en: Early in Xianyong he joined Pacification Commissioner Yelu Zhaosan's campaign against tribes that had defied imperial orders.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong, he followed Pacification Commissioner Yelu Zhaosan in attacking tribal groups that defied orders.

units.zh: 及請降，來介有能躍駝峰而上者，以儇捷相詫。
units.en: When the tribes sued for peace, one envoy could vault onto a camel's hump in a single bound, and they traded boasts of their agility.
units.literal: When they requested surrender, among the envoys was one who could leap onto a camel's hump and up; they boasted to one another of their nimble agility.

units.zh: 趙三問左右誰能此，忽古被重鎧而出，手不及峰，一躍而上，使者大駭。
units.en: Zhaosan asked who among his men could match the feat; Hugu stepped forward in heavy armor, could not reach the hump with his hands, yet vaulted up in one bound—the envoys were astounded.
units.literal: Zhaosan asked those at his side who could do this; Hugu came forth in heavy armor, his hands not reaching the hump, yet with one leap he was atop; the envoys were greatly startled.

units.zh: 趙三以女妻之。
units.en: Zhaosan gave him his daughter in marriage.
units.literal: Zhaosan gave him his daughter in marriage.

units.zh: 帝聞，召為護衛。
units.en: When the emperor heard of this he summoned Hugu into the imperial guard.
units.literal: The emperor heard of it and summoned him as an imperial guard.

units.zh: 時北院樞密使耶律乙辛以狡佞得幸，肆行凶暴。
units.en: At that time Northern Bureau Commissioner Yelu Yixin had won favor through cunning flattery and ruled by violence.
units.literal: At that time the Northern Bureau Commissioner Yelu Yixin, through craftiness and flattery, won favor and wantonly practiced violence and cruelty.

units.zh: 忽古伏於橋下，伺其過，欲殺之。
units.en: Hugu hid beneath a bridge to ambush him as he passed.
units.literal: Hugu lay in wait beneath a bridge, watching for him to pass, intending to kill him.

units.zh: 俄以暴雨壞橋，不果。
units.en: A sudden downpour soon wrecked the bridge, and the attempt came to nothing.
units.literal: Before long a violent rainstorm destroyed the bridge, and it did not succeed.

units.zh: 後又欲殺於獵所，為親友所沮。
units.en: He later planned to strike at the hunting grounds, but kin and friends dissuaded him.
units.literal: Later he again wished to kill him at the hunting grounds, but was dissuaded by kin and friends.

units.zh: 大康三年，復欲殺乙辛及蕭得裏特等，乙辛知而械系之。
units.en: In the third year of Dakang he again plotted to kill Yixin and Xiao Delite; Yixin learned of it and had him arrested in fetters.
units.literal: In the third year of Dakang, he again wished to kill Yixin and Xiao Delite and others; Yixin learned of it and had him shackled and bound.

units.zh: 考劾不服，流於邊。
units.en: Under interrogation he would not confess and was banished to the frontier.
units.literal: Under examination and interrogation he would not confess; he was exiled to the frontier.

units.zh: 及太子廢徙於上京，召忽古至，殺之。
units.en: When the crown prince was deposed and sent to Shangjing, Hugu was summoned there and executed.
units.literal: When the Crown Prince was deposed and moved to Shangjing, Hugu was summoned there and killed.

units.zh: 乾統初，追贈龍虎衛上將軍。
units.en: Early in Qiantong he was posthumously made General-in-Chief of the Dragon-Tiger Guard.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qiantong, he was posthumously granted the rank of General-in-Chief of the Dragon-Tiger Guard.

units.zh: 耶律石柳，字酬宛，六院部人。
units.en: Yelu Shiliu, whose style was Chouwan, came from the Six Chancelleries tribe.
units.literal: Yelu Shiliu, styled Chouwan, was a man of the Six Chancelleries tribe.

units.zh: 祖獨攧，南院大王。
units.en: His grandfather Duzhan had been Great King of the Southern Chancellery.
units.literal: His grandfather Duzhan was Great King of the Southern Chancellery.

units.zh: 父安十，統軍副使。
units.en: His father Anshi had served as deputy army commissioner.
units.literal: His father Anshi was deputy commissioner of the army command.

units.zh: 石柳性剛直，有經世誌。
units.en: Shiliu was upright and unyielding, with a statesman's ambition.
units.literal: Shiliu was by nature upright and unyielding, with the will to order the age.

units.zh: 始為牌印郎君。
units.en: He began his career as Seal and Patent Gentleman.
units.literal: He first served as Seal and Patent Gentleman.

units.zh: 大康初，為夷離畢郎君。
units.en: Early in Dakang he was made Yilibi Gentleman.
units.literal: At the beginning of Dakang, he became Yilibi Gentleman.

units.zh: 時樞密使耶律乙辛誣殺皇后，謀廢太子，斥忠賢，進奸黨，石柳惡其所為，乙辛覺之。
units.en: Bureau Commissioner Yelu Yixin had framed the empress for execution, plotted to depose the crown prince, banished the loyal, and advanced his faction; Shiliu loathed these acts, and Yixin took notice.
units.literal: At that time Bureau Commissioner Yelu Yixin had framed and killed the empress, plotted to depose the Crown Prince, driven out the loyal and worthy, and advanced wicked factions; Shiliu detested his conduct, and Yixin became aware of it.

units.zh: 太子既廢，以石柳附太子，流鎮州。
units.en: After the crown prince was deposed, Shiliu was judged a partisan of the heir and banished to Zhenzhou.
units.literal: Once the Crown Prince was deposed, Shiliu was deemed attached to the Crown Prince and exiled to Zhenzhou.

units.zh: 天祚即位，召為御史中丞。
units.en: When Emperor Tianzuo acceded he was recalled as Vice Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: When Tianzuo took the throne, he was summoned as Vice Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 時方治乙辛黨，有司不以為意。
units.en: The court was supposed to be prosecuting Yixin's faction, yet the responsible offices treated the matter lightly.
units.literal: At that time they were just then prosecuting Yixin's faction, but the responsible offices paid it no heed.

units.zh: 石柳上書曰：
units.en: Shiliu submitted a memorial that read:
units.literal: Shiliu submitted a memorial, saying:

units.zh: 臣前為奸臣所陷，斥竄邊郡。
units.en: Your servant was once framed by wicked ministers and banished to a frontier commandery.
units.literal: Your servant was formerly framed by wicked ministers and driven off to a frontier commandery.

units.zh: 幸蒙召用，不敢隱默。
units.en: Having been fortunate enough to be recalled to service, I dare not hold my tongue.
units.literal: Fortunately I have been favored with recall and employment; I dare not conceal and remain silent.

units.zh: 恩賞明則賢者勸，刑罰當則奸人消。
units.en: When rewards are clear the worthy are encouraged; when punishments are just the wicked vanish.
units.literal: When favors and rewards are clear, the worthy are encouraged; when punishments are fitting, wicked men disappear.

units.zh: 二者既舉，天下不勞而治。
units.en: When both are in place, the realm is governed without strain.
units.literal: Once these two are carried out, all under Heaven is governed without labor.

units.zh: 臣見耶律乙辛身出寒微，位居樞要，竊權肆惡，不勝名狀。
units.en: I have seen Yelu Yixin rise from humble origins to a pivotal post, usurp power, and commit outrages beyond naming.
units.literal: Your servant has seen Yelu Yixin, though born of humble origins, occupy a pivotal post, usurp power and unleash wickedness beyond what can be named.

units.zh: 蔽先帝之明，誣陷順聖，構害忠讜，敗國罔上，自古所無。
units.en: He blinded the late emperor, falsely condemned Emperor Shunsheng, destroyed loyal remonstrators, and ruined the state while deceiving his sovereign—crimes without precedent.
units.literal: He obscured the late emperor's judgment, falsely condemned Emperor Shunsheng, plotted against loyal remonstrators, ruined the state, and deceived his sovereign—crimes without precedent.

units.zh: 賴廟社之休，陛下獲纂成業，積年之冤，一旦洗雪。
units.en: By the grace of the ancestral temples Your Majesty has succeeded to the throne, and wrongs that festered for years may at last be redressed.
units.literal: Relying on the blessing of the ancestral temples and altars, Your Majesty has succeeded to the completed enterprise; wrongs accumulated over years were in one day washed clean.

units.zh: 正陛下英斷，克成孝道之秋。
units.en: This is precisely the moment for Your Majesty's decisive rule to fulfill filial duty.
units.literal: It is just when Your Majesty's keen decisiveness can fully accomplish the season of filial piety.

units.zh: 如蕭得裏特實乙辛之黨，耶律合魯亦不為早辨，賴陛下之明，遂正其事。
units.en: Xiao Delite was truly of Yixin's party, and Yelu Helu failed to expose this in time; only Your Majesty's discernment set the matter right.
units.literal: For example, Xiao Delite was in truth of Yixin's faction, and Yelu Helu also did not distinguish the matter early; relying on Your Majesty's clarity, the affair was then set right.

units.zh: 臣見陛下多疑，故有司顧望，不切推問。
units.en: I fear Your Majesty's excessive caution leaves officials hesitant and unwilling to pursue the case vigorously.
units.literal: Your servant sees that Your Majesty is overly doubtful; therefore the responsible offices look about and hesitate, and do not press the inquiry keenly.

units.zh: 乙辛在先帝朝，權寵無比。
units.en: Under the late emperor Yixin's power and favor were unrivaled.
units.literal: Yixin in the Former Emperor's court had power and favor without parallel.

units.zh: 先帝若以順考為實，則乙辛為功臣，陛下豈得立耶？
units.en: If the late emperor had believed the accusations against your late father, Yixin would count as a meritorious minister—how then could Your Majesty have ascended the throne?
units.literal: If the late emperor had believed the accusations against your late father to be true, then Yixin would have been a meritorious minister—how could Your Majesty have been established?

units.zh: 先帝黜逐嬖後，詔陛下在左右，是亦悔前非也。
units.en: The late emperor dismissed his favorite consort and kept Your Majesty at his side—itself a sign he regretted his earlier error.
units.literal: The Former Emperor drove off the favorite consort and ordered Your Majesty to remain at his side—this too was repentance for former error.

units.zh: 陛下詎可忘父讎不報，寬逆黨不誅？
units.en: How can Your Majesty leave your father's wrongs unavenged and spare the traitorous faction unpunished?
units.literal: How can Your Majesty forget your father's enmity unavenged and pardon the rebellious faction unpunished?

units.zh: 今靈骨未獲，而求之不切。
units.en: Her remains have yet to be recovered, yet the search is pursued without urgency.
units.literal: Now her sacred bones have not been recovered, yet the search for them is not keen.

units.zh: 《傳》曰，聖人之德，無加於孝。
units.en: The Zhuan says that among a sage's virtues none surpasses filial piety.
units.literal: The Zhuan says: among the sage's virtues, none surpasses filial piety.

units.zh: 昔唐德宗因亂失母，思慕悲傷，孝道益著。
units.en: Tang Dezong once lost his mother in the turmoil of rebellion; his longing and grief made his filial devotion all the more renowned.
units.literal: Formerly Tang Dezong, through disorder, lost his mother; in longing and grief his filial piety became all the more manifest.

units.zh: 周公誅飛廉、惡來，天下大悅。
units.en: When the Duke of Zhou executed Feilian and Elai, the realm rejoiced.
units.literal: The Duke of Zhou executed Feilian and Elai, and all under Heaven were greatly pleased.

units.zh: 今逆黨未除，大冤不報，上無以慰順考之靈，下無以釋天下之憤。
units.en: The traitorous faction still stands unpunished and the great wrong unavenged; your late father's spirit finds no comfort, and the people's outrage finds no release.
units.literal: Now the rebellious faction has not been removed and the great wrong has not been avenged; above, there is no means to console the spirit of your late father, and below, no means to release the anger of all under Heaven.

units.zh: 怨氣上結，水旱為沴。
units.en: Resentment gathers toward heaven, and flood and drought follow as portents.
units.literal: Resentment's qi rises and knots; flood and drought become calamities.

units.zh: 臣願陛下下明詔，求順考之瘞所，盡收逆黨以正邦憲，快四方忠義之心，昭國家賞罰之用，然後致治之道可得而舉矣。
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to issue a clear edict, find your late father's burial place, apprehend the entire traitorous faction to uphold the law, satisfy loyal subjects everywhere, and make the state's rewards and punishments plain—only then can good governance truly be pursued.
units.literal: Your servant wishes Your Majesty to issue a clear edict, seek the burial place of your late father, fully apprehend the rebellious faction to rectify the laws of the state, satisfy the hearts of the loyal and righteous in the four quarters, and make manifest the state's use of rewards and punishments—then the way of bringing order may be taken up and carried out.

units.zh: 謹別錄順聖升遐及乙辛等事，昧死以聞。
units.en: I respectfully attach a separate record of Emperor Shunsheng's death and Yixin's crimes, and risk my life to lay this before Your Majesty.
units.literal: Respectfully I separately record the death of Emperor Shunsheng and matters concerning Yixin and the others, risking death to report.

units.zh: 書奏不報，聞者莫不嘆惋。
units.en: The memorial went unanswered, and all who heard of it sighed in dismay.
units.literal: The memorial was submitted but received no response; those who heard of it none failed to sigh in regret.

units.zh: 乾統中，遙授靜江軍節度使，卒。
units.en: Under Qiantong he was given the nominal post of military commissioner of the Jingjiang Army and later died.
units.literal: During Qiantong, he was remotely appointed military commissioner of the Jingjiang Army, and died.

units.zh: 子馬哥，同中書門下平章事。
units.en: His son Mage rose to Grand Councilor of the Imperial Secretariat.
units.literal: His son Mage became Grand Councilor of the Imperial Secretariat.

units.zh: 論曰：《易》言「履霜，堅冰至」，謹始也。
units.en: Commentary: The Book of Changes says, "When frost is underfoot, solid ice is not far behind"—a warning to be careful at the outset.
units.literal: The commentary says: The Book of Changes says, "Treading on frost, solid ice arrives"—this is caution at the beginning.

units.zh: 使道宗能從巖壽、撒剌之諫，後何得而誣，太子何得而廢哉？
units.en: Had Emperor Daozong heeded Yanshou and Sala, how could those frame-ups have followed, or the crown prince been deposed?
units.literal: If Emperor Daozong could have followed the remonstrances of Yanshou and Sala, how could there later have been framing accusations, how could the Crown Prince have been deposed?

units.zh: 速撒、撻不也以忠言見殺，國欲無亂，得乎？
units.en: Susa and Tabuye were slain for honest counsel—could the realm hope to escape turmoil after that?
units.literal: Susa and Tabuye were killed for loyal words—could the state wish to be without disorder and achieve it?

units.zh: 石柳之書，亦幸出於乙辛既敗之後，獲行其說。
units.en: Shiliu's memorial, fortunately submitted only after Yixin's fall, at least found partial fulfillment.
units.literal: Shiliu's memorial also fortunately appeared after Yixin had already been defeated, and thus his argument could be carried out.

units.zh: 有國家者，可不知人哉！
units.en: Can any ruler afford not to know his men!
units.literal: One who possesses a state—how can he not know men!
